brief:
Palestinians in Gaza hold little hope that Israel's election will improve their circumstances, according to Al Jazeera English. After years of conflict, displacement and movement restrictions, residents question whether a change in Israeli leadership will alter policies toward the territory.

The election outcome appears unlikely to shift the fundamental conditions facing Gazans, who have endured prolonged warfare and blockade measures that have restricted access to resources and freedom of movement across the enclave.
dek: After years of war, displacement and restrictions, Gazans ask whether Israel’s election will affect their future.
title: Gazans doubt Israeli election will ease blockade and displacement
